verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pipedream acting only as an MCP server: its remote MCP server exposes its 3,000+ API integrations to external MCP clients and agents. Nothing shows Pipedream, or its AI agent builder, connecting to third-party MCP servers to consume their tools. The server-side role does not transfer to this client-side story, and a workflow or agent platform could plausibly ship MCP-client support, so the axis applies and lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
